rows.en: Taboo Dopant!! You don't have to tell me, I'll take you down!
Oh? What's the matter?
Fufufu...!! How amusing!
Now then, where to next, I wonder?
Oh? What's the matter?
Fufufu...!! How amusing!
Now then, where to next, I wonder?
Oh? What's the matter?
Fufufu...!! How amusing!
Now then, where to next, I wonder?
Oh? What's the matter?
Fufufu...!! How amusing!
Now then, where to next, I wonder?
My, you've arrived already? Well, never mind.
Taboo Dopant...! You never had a power like this before!
Tch! What the hell is going on!!
Fufufufufu. It's all thanks to the Zone Dopant, you see.
Ufufufu... That was fun.
Yes, just a little game using its "power to instantly send an opponent somewhere else."
Thanks to it, I bought myself plenty of time. My goal is as good as achieved.
All that's left is to dispose of you all!! Here I come!!
Hmph, what a pain of an enemy that was. Hey! Let's check out that display stand over there.
Yeah! Good call!!
W examined the display stand.
On it was the "Xtreme Memory"!
Obtained the "Xtreme Memory". W can now use a new skill.
All right!! We finally found it!!
I won't... let you have it that easily!!
You're still alive...!! Sorry! We've already taken our Memory back!!
I-I won't forgive you!! Kamen Rider W!!
Whoa!! ...Where's all that power coming from!?
In that case, let's put the Xtreme Memory to use right away!
Now, count up your sins!!
Ugh... But it's already too late.
Father and the others' plan... You can't stop the "Gaia Impact"...
The "Gaia Impact"!? Hey!! What do you mean by that!!
But Taboo Dopant had already breathed her last.
Yo!! Looks like you're hard at work!!
Oh! Birth and Accel! So, how's the investigation going?
Just as we thought, the enemy is pushing ahead with a large-scale "plan" behind the scenes.
Hm...? By that plan, do you mean the "Gaia Impact"?
Wh-what!? How do you know about that!?
Taboo Dopant told us just now.
I see. Either way, we'd better sort through what we know.
This isn't really the place, so let's head back to base.
{8074} and the team examined the display stand.
On it was the "Xtreme Memory"!
Obtained the "Xtreme Memory". W can now use a new skill.
Ugh... But it's already too late.
You...!! You're still...!!
Father and the others' plan... You can't stop the "Gaia Impact"...
The "Gaia Impact"...!? Hey!! What the hell is that!!
But Taboo Dopant had already breathed her last.
Yo!! Looks like you're hard at work!!
Huh!? Oh, it's just Birth.
Hey, what's with "just Birth"? We're out here risking our necks investigating too, y'know.
So, did you find anything out?
Just as we thought, the enemy is pushing ahead with a large-scale "plan" behind the scenes.
This plan of theirs... You mean the "Gaia Impact"?
Wh-what!? How do you know about that!?
The enemy we just took down let it slip.
I see. Either way, we'd better sort through what we know.
This isn't really the place, so let's head back to base.
Meanwhile...
I see... So Taboo has fallen...
But I won't let them run wild any longer! It seems Ikadevil has completed the Shocker Greeed, too.
Then why don't you try using that tyrant monster of yours as well?
We can't keep it locked in its cage forever. It's time you let it rampage. Can you manage that?
Of course.
Fu fu fu... Our Museum is overwhelming!!
By the way... About the "plan"...
No need to worry there. All the Gaia Gates are proceeding smoothly.
Hm. Then setting off the "Gaia Impact" is only a matter of time. Hahahahahaha!!
The "Gaia Impact," huh...
Yeah. In our original world, as I recall... it drains the "Earth's memories" from the Gaia Gate
and wipes out everyone except those compatible with Gaia Memories. It's a terrifying plan.
I see... Then carrying out that plan would require a Gaia Gate, wouldn't it?
Of course. The whole plan hinges on it.
From what I heard from the enemy, there's something like a well underground.
What!?

notes.note: Last row of the party-leader variant block that starts in story_101 (0571.4-0571.16). Its source matches 0571.4 and 0571.11-16, so it should use the same English as those rows.
0572-0575 are four identical Taboo taunts, one for each Zone Dopant teleport, so all four use the same English.
Extracted speaker is Zone Dopant, gloating after the teleport game. Label kept.
Literally 'where on earth is that power from'. Written without a pronoun.
'Father' = Terror Dopant, Saeko's father, as in earlier slices. 'Gaia Impact' is not in the glossary, so I used the official W term.
Extracted speaker is W (Philip), but the rough 'Hey!!' sounds like Shotaro. Kept the extracted label and wording.
'her' follows the glossary (g=f for Taboo Dopant/Saeko).
0.18-0.40 is the branch where W leads; 0.46-0.63 is the other branch, where Ankh leads. Lines shared by both branches use identical English.
'that tyrant monster' read as Tyrant, the Ultra kaiju whose title is Tyrant Monster. Kept lowercase and descriptive because Terror is only alluding to it.
The source says the Gaia Gates themselves are 'progressing smoothly', meaning the work at them. Kept close to that.

No speakers were recovered for 0.93-0.99 (the base meeting). 0.94/0.95 is a W-world character (Philip, Shotaro or Accel) explaining the Gaia Impact. 0.98 is whoever heard it from the enemy, probably Accel or Birth. The sentence split across 0.94/0.95 is cut at the same point. Wording works for any of these speakers.
'Earth's memories' renders the Earth's-memory term glossed 'hoshi', matching earlier slices.

report: 80/80 rows. 'Gaia Impact' is not in the glossary (used the official W term). 0.31 is labelled Philip but the wording is rough. 0.93-0.99 have no recovered speakers. 0.71 'tyrant monster' read as Tyrant.
